decisions.question: Auto-confirmation trigger
decisions.answer: Cloud Function on webhook — server-side, no client race condition
decisions.rationale: Webhook handler runs server-side, can safely apply business logic without exposing to client

decisions.question: Slot capacity concurrency
decisions.rationale: Prevents double-booking same slot; transaction guarantees consistency

decisions.question: Countdown timer implementation
decisions.rationale: Client-side timers can be manipulated; server-side ensures accuracy

decisions.question: On-demand access gating
decisions.rationale: Explicit access control, scalable for future content restrictions

decisions.question: Auto-confirm vs manual-confirm branching
decisions.rationale: Chat, Yoga, Edukasi, Bundling = auto; Offline = manual optional
